items.title: Colgate Palmolive (CL) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Q3 Earnings Beat

items.title: Oil edges higher as mixed U.S.-Iran signals temper peace hopes
items.summary: Investing.com-- Oil prices edged higher in Asian trading on Wednesday as investors weighed mixed signals on the prospects for a U.S.-Iran peace deal, while assessing the implications of the U.S. midterm elections for the conflict.

items.title: Gold holds near $3,930 as Iran talks, U.S. midterms shape outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Gold prices held near $3,930 an ounce on Tuesday as investors monitored fresh diplomatic efforts to resolve the U.S.-Iran conflict and awaited U.S. midterm election results for clues on the outlook for interest rates and fiscal policy.

items.title: Canadian crude discount with U.S. at widest level since 2018
items.summary: Investing.com -- Canadian heavy crude prices fell to their weakest level relative to US oil futures since 2018, when a pipeline bottleneck led Alberta's government to impose production limits on major producers.

items.title: TSX futures drop amid rise in oil prices; U.S. midterm elections ahead
items.summary: Investing.com - Futures connected to Canada’s main stock index pointed lower on Tuesday, as investors assessed a renewed jump in oil prices and looked ahead to the U.S. midterm elections.

items.title: Apple, Palantir report; U.S. midterm elections ahead - what’s moving markets
items.summary: Investing.com - Futures linked to the main U.S. stock indices are subdued, as investors assessed a fresh batch of technology sector earnings and looked ahead to the much-anticipated American midterm elections. Apple and Palantir shares dip in extended hours trading after the two companies’ latest quarterly reports, while artificial intelligence and affordability are likely to be key issues for American voters.
